title: shoken-model: 全国471,024メッシュで測った店舗立地の予測可能性
description:
Fits Poisson location models for 30 retail, food-service and personal-service formats over all 471,024 inhabited 500 m mesh cells of Japan (125.3 million people), and validates them prospectively against 74,507 actual store openings drawn from three public licensing registries (liquor retail licences, food-hygiene filings, and health-insurance provider designations).

Four principal results: (1) Ranking empty cells works — the top 10% of cells captured 75.1% of new convenience stores, a 7.5x lift (95% CI 7.3-7.7), confirmed by leave-one-prefecture-out validation across 46 prefectures. (2) A single national model suffices; coefficients fitted on one prefecture transfer with a penalty of at most 0.031 AUC, even though individual coefficients vary threefold across prefectures. (3) The direction of the question matters — where a given format goes is predictable, but which format appears in a given cell is not (mean AUC 0.508), because population, employment, roads, stations and land use push every format the same way. (4) Daytime employment is the only feature that helps (+0.035 to +0.057 urban AUC); age structure, land price, station ridership and building counts add nothing, and the latter two are absorbed by employment.

Decomposition of clustering: chain agglomeration is dominant-strategy expansion — a chain's own local share discriminates its openings from rivals' at AUC 0.57-0.93 — while independent-store agglomeration repels chains and is not explained by terrain, history or zoning (at most 31% of the explainable residual, and mostly by neighbouring residuals rather than any site attribute).

全国471,024メッシュ・30業種の立地を、公的な許認可3系統から集めた74,507件の実際の開店で前向きに検証した記録。まだ1店も無いマスの順位づけは7.5倍で当たり、全国1つのモデルで足りる。ただし「どこか」は当てられても「何の店か」は当てられない。効いた特徴量は従業者数だけで、集積の正体はドミナント出店だった。

Note on data: This license covers the source code. Aggregated mesh data is included in public/; raw place data is not bundled and retains the terms of its source (Foursquare OS Places, Apache 2.0). Government sources are listed in README.md.
